name: Birth
overview: Scripture reveals birth as a profound and divinely ordained event marked by both joy and sorrow. The pain and travail associated with childbirth, as described in Genesis 3:16 and Isaiah 13:8, reflect the fallen condition of humanity, yet children are also portrayed as a precious heritage and reward from the Lord (Psalms 127:3). The miraculous birth of Christ stands at the center of this theme, emphasizing God's provision of a Savior whose birth brings peace and hope to the world (Isaiah 9:6). Additionally, God's intimate involvement in the formation of life is affirmed in Psalms 139:13, underscoring the sacredness of birth as part of His sovereign design.
